red_corridor.speaker: Her
red_corridor.line_1: Contact. Host organism rooted in the lane. Stable. Waiting on me.
red_corridor.line_2: It wants in. Clean bond window. Could be useful. Could be permanent.

red_corridor.speaker: Her
red_corridor.line_1: Movement. Mutation egg. Thin shell. Still twitching.
red_corridor.line_2: Something inside wants out. I can claim it first... or walk past.

red_corridor.speaker: Her
red_corridor.line_1: Wall on my left is breathing out of sync with the rest of the corridor.
red_corridor.line_2: Could be a cache. Could be a mouth. I can cut it, tap it, or keep moving.

red_corridor.speaker: Her
red_corridor.line_1: Tracks in the membrane. Human stride. Old, but not ancient.
red_corridor.line_2: Somebody else made this walk and didn't clean up after.

red_corridor.speaker: Her
red_corridor.line_1: Lane stays quiet. Heat steady. No movement worth spending blood on.

amber_corridor.speaker: Her
amber_corridor.line_1: Amber sacs under the wall skin. Fresh. Pressurized.
amber_corridor.line_2: I can cut one free, seal myself with it, or leave the whole mess alone.

amber_corridor.speaker: Her
amber_corridor.line_1: Something hard is set inside the amber. Tool shape. Maybe bone. Maybe metal.
amber_corridor.line_2: I can crack it out now... or keep my hands clean.

amber_corridor.speaker: Her
amber_corridor.line_1: Heat's climbing. Resin's cooking in the walls.
amber_corridor.line_2: Good place to get stuck. Bad place to slow down.

amber_corridor.speaker: Her
amber_corridor.line_1: No rupture. No harvest. Just slow pulses under the skin.

split_green_corridor.speaker: Her
split_green_corridor.line_1: Split ahead. Left branch is soft and warm. Right branch is green spine and hard shell.
split_green_corridor.line_2: One path feeds growth. One path fights back. Both want something.

split_green_corridor.speaker: Her
split_green_corridor.line_1: Spores drifting low through the branch mouths. Fine enough to miss if I'm sloppy.
split_green_corridor.line_2: I can hold breath and move, stir them on purpose, or back off and reassess.

split_green_corridor.speaker: Her
split_green_corridor.line_1: The green holds. No rupture yet.
split_green_corridor.line_2: I pick a line and keep pressure on it.

split_red_corridor.speaker: Her
split_red_corridor.line_1: Fork around a swollen artery and a dry cracking lane.
split_red_corridor.line_2: One spills if I open it. One tears if I force it. Both cost.

split_red_corridor.speaker: Her
split_red_corridor.line_1: Pressure climbing in the walls. Whole split feels ready to burst.
split_red_corridor.line_2: I can move fast, cut a vent, or get clear before it chooses for me.

bone_corridor.speaker: Her
bone_corridor.line_1: Contact. Marrow sentinel in the lane. Still enough bone here to build an army.
bone_corridor.line_2: If I want what it guards, I cut it down.

bone_corridor.speaker: Her
bone_corridor.line_1: Bone piles stacked waist high. Some of it human. Some of it definitely not.
bone_corridor.line_2: There might be gear under the rot. There might be company.

bone_corridor.speaker: Her
bone_corridor.line_1: Bone underfoot. Bone in the walls. Bone in the air.

spiked_red_corridor.speaker: Her
spiked_red_corridor.line_1: Spikes forcing up through the floor and walls. Lane's closing while I watch.
spiked_red_corridor.line_2: I can push through, break a lane, or back off before I get pinned.

spiked_red_corridor.speaker: Her
spiked_red_corridor.line_1: Spines everywhere. No clean route. Just a least-worst one.
spiked_red_corridor.line_2: I keep my center low and move.

organ_chamber_red.speaker: Her
organ_chamber_red.line_1: Visual on the chamber core. Heart suspended center-mass. Keeper between me and it.
organ_chamber_red.line_2: If I want the chamber open, the keeper dies first.

organ_chamber_red.speaker: Her
organ_chamber_red.line_1: Chamber pulse is syncing to my breathing. I don't like that.
organ_chamber_red.line_2: I can steady up, cut the hanging cords, or get clear before it learns me.

organ_chamber_red.speaker: Her
organ_chamber_red.line_1: Core's still beating. Whole room listens when it does.
organ_chamber_red.line_2: I move before it decides I'm part of it.

healing_pool.speaker: Her
healing_pool.line_1: Pool ahead. Smells clean. Wrong kind of clean.
healing_pool.line_2: I can drink, test it, or back off before it gets inside me.

healing_pool.speaker: Her
healing_pool.line_1: Surface moved before I touched it. Something under there. Maybe reacting. Maybe waiting.
healing_pool.line_2: I can break the skin, sample the edge, or leave it still.

healing_pool.speaker: Her
healing_pool.line_1: No splash. No movement. Glow stays steady.
healing_pool.line_2: I mark the chamber and keep moving.

egg_corridor.speaker: Her
egg_corridor.line_1: Egg line both sides. Full sacs. One already open.
egg_corridor.line_2: I can harvest, burn a lane, or slip through before the nest wakes up.

egg_corridor.speaker: Her
egg_corridor.line_1: Cracked shell on the right. Whatever hatched left fluid and drag marks.
egg_corridor.line_2: I can check the shell, track the hatchling, or move before it circles back.

egg_corridor.speaker: Her
egg_corridor.line_1: Nest stays still. That's worse than noise.
egg_corridor.line_2: I keep my steps light and get through.

corruption_spike_room.speaker: Her
corruption_spike_room.line_1: Spikes breaching ahead. Bone pressure's rising fast.
corruption_spike_room.line_2: If I push through, I pay for it in blood.

symbiote_host_offer.speaker: Her
symbiote_host_offer.line_1: Host organism separated from the wall. Mobile enough to bond. Quiet enough to trust. Maybe.
symbiote_host_offer.line_2: Decision point. Let it in... or keep my body mine.

merchant_arrival.speaker: Merchant
merchant_arrival.line_1: Five chambers down and you still look profitable.
merchant_arrival.line_2: Browse... or keep pretending you don't need me.

danger_spike_notice.speaker: Her
danger_spike_notice.line_1: Adrenaline climbing. Corridor's reacting to it. I'm getting louder to this place.
danger_spike_notice.line_2: Next contact will come faster. So will I.

floor_transition.speaker: Her
floor_transition.line_1: Layer break. Pressure changed. Smell changed. Rules probably changed too.
floor_transition.line_2: I reset my breathing and keep moving.
